segments.title: Chương 29: 0029
segments.content:
The dilapidated bus and shabby county road that appalled Bian Guanyue were common sights in Chen Guiliang's student days.

When he was in junior high, Chen Guiliang couldn't even afford the dilapidated bus.

After a bumpy two-hour ride, Chen Guiliang once again arrived at school, as if stepping into another world.

In 2003, China was naturally divided into many, many worlds.

To the farmers, the poor and dilapidated small county town was already a paradise.

"Country bumpkin" had even become a swear word; even the ordinary lower-class citizens in the towns could curse at people with "country bumpkin" without any guilt.

Chen Guiliang got off the bus at the school gate and first went to the roadside pharmacy to weigh himself.

117.6 jin!

The weight gain plan was going very smoothly. Eating his fill of meat and vegetables at every meal, he was gaining an average of 0.7 jin a day.

It was like he was eating pig feed.

His sunken cheeks were visibly fuller.

He returned to the dormitory in high spirits. Only Xu Haibo and Yang Hao were there.

Chen Guiliang asked, "They haven't returned to school yet?"

Xu Haibo said, "They went to play basketball. Only that perv Xie Sao Bang was acting all sneaky. I'm guessing he went to an internet cafe."

"That son of a bitch, he's definitely going to weasel out of eating shit," Chen Guiliang cursed with a laugh.

Xu Haibo said, "There was a parent-teacher conference today. Your parents didn't come again, and Teacher Liu got angry on the spot. He even criticized Bian Guanyue's parents, saying she shouldn't have skipped class with you."

"I was on leave," Chen Guiliang corrected.

Xu Haibo reminded him, "You still haven't submitted your leave request slip."

Chen Guiliang stopped arguing. He took out the Grade 10 textbooks he'd brought from home and sat in the dormitory, reviewing them seriously.

Concepts like sine, tangent, and cosine were a blur to him; he had to start from the basics and catch up bit by bit.

Even by dinnertime, that fellow Xie Yang still hadn't shown up. He probably really did sneak off to an internet cafe.

Carrying his Grade 10 math book, Chen Guiliang first went to the cafeteria for dinner, then to the classroom for evening self-study.

Before long, Bian Guanyue and Zheng Feng entered the classroom one after the other.

Bian Guanyue walked into the classroom expressionlessly, but when she reached Chen Guiliang's side, she took the initiative to greet him.

Chen Guiliang lowered his voice and said deeply, "I am Qin Shi Huang."

Bian Guanyue actually had a very low boiling point for laughter. Hearing this, she couldn't hold it in. She recalled the phone call from two nights ago and couldn't help asking with a hint of a smile, "Do I give you the money now?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Proceed as planned."

Bian Guanyue took out ten yuan. "This is all I have."

Chen Guiliang said, "A vast ocean does not refuse the smallest stream."

"Where is Qin Shi Huang's token?" Bian Guanyue asked.

Chen Guiliang took out the pebble, spouting earnest nonsense, "The He Shi Bi was made into the Imperial Seal of the Realm back then, and some scraps were left over. This jade is one of them. I hope you will treasure it. When I, Zhen, open the Mausoleum of the First Qin Emperor, recruit troops, and rebuild the Great Qin Empire, you may present this token to be enfeoffed as my Empress!"

"Then I'll be waiting," Bian Guanyue said, biting her lip to keep from laughing.

Chen Guiliang gave the pebble away as a gift and actually accepted Bian Guanyue's start-up fund.

A penny-pincher hitting on a girl without spending a dime, and even managing to make a profit of ten yuan.

Bian Guanyue began to play with the pebble.

This broken stone was about the size of a quail egg. Its white body did look a bit like jade, and there was a blue stripe running through the middle.

It was quite pretty.

Bian Guanyue put the stone in her pencil case.

Zheng Feng had been standing nearby the whole time, not understanding what they were talking about.

What the hell was this about Qin Shi Huang?

And rebuilding the Great Qin Empire and making Bian Guanyue the Empress?

Bian Guanyue actually accepted the broken stone, and she was smiling the whole time. She never smiles at me!

What on earth happened when you two went to the city to get the computer fixed?

I haven't seen you for two days over the weekend, how did everything change?

Zheng Feng looked at Chen Guiliang, then at Bian Guanyue, feeling as if he were already out of the game.

"Want to listen to some music?" Bian Guanyue took out her MP3 player.

"Sure."

Chen Guiliang figured out the left and right sides and put one of the earbuds in his ear.

Under Zheng Feng's dumbfounded gaze, Bian Guanyue picked up the other earbud and put it in her ear. These two were actually sharing a pair of earbuds to listen to music, and their actions looked so natural?

This definitely wasn't the first time.

Oh my god!

Zheng Feng began to doubt his existence.

A little while later, Wang Siyu came for self-study.

Just as she was putting down her schoolbag, she also saw the bizarre scene and whispered to Zheng Feng, "What's up with them?"

"Don't disturb my studies!" Zheng Feng was extremely annoyed.

Wang Siyu pouted, thinking to herself: Why are you taking it out on me? If you've got a problem, take it up with Chen Guiliang.

Li Jun came into the classroom holding a basketball, once again drenched in sweat.

He had been pursuing Ou Yafei from the class next door for the past two days, but had been scared into giving up halfway—Ou Yafei's father had beaten up her ex-boyfriend.

The reason was that the ex-boyfriend, bitter about the breakup, had spread a nasty rumor, claiming Ou Yafei had gotten an abortion for him during the summer break.

How did Li Jun know?

Because Ou Yafei's ex-boyfriend was one of his buddies from the school basketball team!

During the parent-teacher conference today, they had gone to the now-closed Chengbei Elementary School to play basketball. That elementary school was right next to No. 2 Middle School; it had already been merged and had no students, and in a few years it would become the junior high campus of No. 2 Middle School.

After the parent-teacher conference, Ou Yafei's father charged directly to the basketball court at Chengbei Elementary and beat his daughter's ex-boyfriend black and blue in front of everyone.

Li Jun witnessed the entire thing. The more he thought about it, the more scared he became. He decided Bian Guanyue was a better fit for him after all.

Li Jun walked excitedly to Bian Guanyue's desk. "Bian Guanyue, a bubble tea shop just opened in the county town. Do you know about bubble tea? It came over from Taiwan. Let me tell you, business is booming. There was a huge line on opening day."

This rundown county town, in the year 2003, finally had its first bubble tea shop.

And it would be another two years before the first fast-food restaurant appeared. At that time, all the rich people in the county drove their cars to queue up at Dicos, causing local traffic jams for several days straight.

Bian Guanyue turned a deaf ear, continuing to do her problems with her head down.

Li Jun asked again, "Have you ever tried bubble tea? I waited in line for 40 minutes yesterday to finally get a cup. It's really delicious. Truly a drink from Taiwan. I'll bring you a cup tomorrow at noon."

Bian Guanyue continued to do her problems.

Li Jun finally noticed something was off. He saw Chen Guiliang and Bian Guanyue sharing a pair of earbuds.

The guy didn't think much of it; it was normal for male and female classmates to listen to music together. He often shared earbuds with girls too, but most of them weren't his girlfriends. He had only officially dated one girl in Grade 11.

But at this moment, he was jealous and furious.

Bian Guanyue was supposed to be his deskmate, and he should be the one listening to music with her!

"Yo, Great Hero Chen, your sleeves are all torn. Can't bear to get a new one?"

Li Jun reverted to his trash-talking mode. "Don't have the money to buy one? Want me to lend you some?"

If this were the student-era Chen Guiliang, and Li Jun dared to mock his poverty, he would have cursed him out on the spot, and it might have even ended in a fight.

But Chen Guiliang, with the soul of a 40-year-old in his body, simply looked up with a smile and said, "Yeah, I don't have money for clothes. Thanks for your concern, classmate Li Jun. Are you really willing to lend me money to buy clothes?"

"What?" Li Jun thought he had misheard.

Chen Guiliang's reaction was completely beyond his expectation.

Chen Guiliang actually held out his hand. "I'm so poor I don't even have enough for meals. I've been wanting to buy a new shirt. Classmate Li Jun, could you lend me two hundred?"

Li Jun instantly remembered how he had been swindled out of a hundred yuan for changing seats during evening self-study that day. He subconsciously took two steps back and sneered sarcastically, "I'm not your dad. What you wear is none of my damn business!"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "Then what the hell are you talking about if you don't have money! I thought you were going to show some filial piety to your dad. Raised such a big son for nothing. Should've just shot you into the toilet back then."

"Say that again, you motherfucker!"

Li Jun rushed forward and grabbed Chen Guiliang by the collar.

He was quite strong, but luckily the shirt didn't rip, or Chen Guiliang would have had a reason to extort him.

"Li Jun, don't bully your classmate!" Bian Guanyue immediately spoke up to stop him.

She wasn't actually afraid of Chen Guiliang getting beaten up, because she knew he was tough. But Chen Guiliang was currently under school probation, and another fight would surely get him expelled.

Li Jun grew even angrier and questioned Bian Guanyue without a shred of self-awareness, "You're actually helping him?"

Bian Guanyue said righteously, "If you two fight, I can be a witness. To testify that you were the one who provoked him, and you were the one who started it!"

Zheng Feng watched the drama unfold with a grin.

Although he disliked Chen Guiliang, he actually detested Li Jun even more. He was hoping Chen Guiliang would give Li Jun a good beating.

Feeling the grip on his sleeve tighten, Chen Guiliang yelled at the top of his lungs, "Li Jun's hitting someone! Li Jun's hitting someone!"

Hearing this, all the students in the classroom turned to look.

Xie Yang, who had just returned to the classroom from the internet cafe, didn't even bother to figure out what was going on before rushing over in a few strides with a flying kick. "Fuck you, you dare hit my brother!"

When the county magistrate arrives, justice is served! Goose Town is at peace!

This guy really showed up when it mattered.

Xu Haibo and the other guys from Dorm 302 also ran over to back them up, but they only dared to run their mouths, not throw punches.

The class president, Li Rui, shouted, "Don't fight, don't fight!"

Several other class officers also chimed in, trying to break it up.

Xie Yang's kick almost knocked Li Jun over, and the two were soon entangled.

Chen Guiliang, shouting "don't fight," pretended to pull them apart. But using Xie Yang to block everyone's view, he landed a vicious, sneaky punch on Li Jun's waist.

A kidney shot.

Li Jun instantly bent over in pain, unable to even speak. Chen Guiliang took the opportunity to separate him from Xie Yang.

Xie Yang pointed at Li Jun and cursed, "I'll beat you to death, you son of a bitch!"

Chen Guiliang sighed inwardly. He hadn't planned to get physical tonight and had even wanted to use it as an excuse to extort some money, but he couldn't stop Xie Yang from jumping in to help.

Purely an accident.

Xie Yang coolly flicked his hair and patted his chest, saying to Chen Guiliang, "You're on probation. If you fight again, you'll be expelled. From now on, leave the fighting to me. The worst I'll get is a major demerit!"

Chen Guiliang thought: Brother, for saying that, I'll make sure you have enough pork belly for a lifetime.

Xu Haibo also stood by and cheered, "Xie Sao Bang is a true bro!"

The class president, Li Rui, ran over to help Li Jun up. "Are you hurt?"

This guy Li Jun wasn't the sharpest tool in the shed. He didn't seize the chance to make a fuss and go to the hospital. Instead, to save face, he gritted his teeth and stood up, pretending to be fine. "Hurt? I'm on the school basketball team! I wouldn't get hurt even if ten more of them came at me. I could take on a hundred of them."

"Come on, come on, let's go another round," Xie Yang taunted.

Except for Yang Hao, who was more timid, all the guys from Dorm 302 surrounded them.

They didn't dare to fight, but they were more than enough to boost morale.

The seven of them completely encircled Li Jun.

Seeing this formation, Li Jun didn't even dare to curse loudly. Muttering something under his breath, he blustered as he pushed Xu Haibo aside and returned to his seat, still grumbling.

Class president Li Rui let out a sigh of relief and quickly shouted, "Evening self-study is about to start. Go back, everyone go back to your seats."

Chen Guiliang cupped his fists toward the brothers from 302. "Tomorrow at noon, my treat. We'll get some stir-fry at the school gate!"

"You got it, haha." The group laughed and dispersed.

Yang Hao furtively returned to his seat. He hadn't come over to help just now and felt like a bad friend, and he was afraid his roommates would ostracize him for it.

In an instant, the classroom returned to its quiet state.

Bian Guanyue handed back the earbud Chen Guiliang had taken out and asked with concern, "Are you really short on money?"

"I'm alright," Chen Guiliang said.

Afraid of hurting his pride, Bian Guanyue said cautiously, "I can lend you money to buy clothes. The weather is getting colder... Don't overthink it, I don't mean anything else by it, and I'm not looking down on you. It's just... um, it's just that you took me to get my computer fixed. Classmates should help each other out."

Such words from a beautiful girl could very well make a poor boy feel embarrassed.

The high school-aged Chen Guiliang would have definitely refused on the spot to protect his pitiful pride.

But the current Chen Guiliang took the opportunity to press his advantage, saying with a grin, "I'm not very good at picking out clothes. The ones I buy always look terrible. How about we go to a shop together this weekend? You can help me pick out styles and colors then?"

Bian Guanyue was willing to lend him money, but she didn't want to go shopping with him, afraid it would cause misunderstandings.

She hesitated for a while, but finding it hard to refuse, finally agreed, "Alright."

(Asking for monthly tickets.)
